title: Flow cytometry-based ex vivo murine NK cell cytotoxicity assay
protocol: Activate NK cells using poly(I:C) in vivo.
Prepare 300 μg poly(I:C) in DPBS, total volume of 200 μl for each mouse.
Inject the prepared poly(I:C) solution intraperitoneally into each mouse.
Sacrifice mice and isolate splenocytes from their spleens.
Place isolated spleens into 1.5 ml cRPMI media on ice.
Isolate the spleen tissue from the pooled mice onto a 70 μm cell filter placed in a petri dish.
Add 2 mL of 1X ACK lysis buffer directly onto the spleens on the filter.
Crush spleens through the filter using a 3-mL syringe plunger.
Transfer all volume into a 15-mL conical tube.
Rinse petri dish with 13 mL DPBS and transfer into the same 15-mL conical tube.
Centrifuge cells at 400 × g, 4 min, at 20°C–25°C, aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 500 μL sterile FACS buffer.
Count live cells with AOPI on the cellometer.
Enrich for NK cells using the STEM CELL TECHNOLOGIES NK EasySep purification kit.
Using cell counts from step 3i, bring cells to the concentration of 1 × 10^8 cells/mL in the 15-mL conical in sterile FACS buffer.
If the cell count is less than 1 × 10^8 cells/mL, proceed with a minimum volume of 500 μl.
Add 50 μl of Isolation Cocktail per mL of sample and mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 10 min.
Vortex RapidSpheres for 30 s to disperse the particles thoroughly.
Add 100 μL of RapidSpheres per mL of sample and mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 5 min.
If the sample volume is greater than 2 mL, divide into 2 tubes with no more than 2 mL in each tube.
Q.S. to 2.5 mL with sterile FACS buffer.
Mix by gently pipetting then carefully transfer the whole 2.5 mL into a 5-mL polypropylene tube.
Plate the tube without lid into the magnet, and incubate at 20°C–25°C for 5 min.
Carefully pick up the magnet with the tube inside it, then invert the magnet, and tube to decant the enriched cells into a new 15-mL conical tube.
Remove the 5-mL polypropylene tube from the magnet, q.s. to 2.5 mL with sterile FACS buffer and mix.
Plate the tube back into the magnet again, and incubate at 20°C–25°C for 5 min.
Carefully pick up the magnet with the tube sitting inside it, then invert the magnet and tube to decant the enriched cells into the same 15-mL conical as step (k).
Prepare complete NK media fresh for each use.
Centrifuge enriched cells at 400 × g for 4 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Resuspend centrifuged cells in 300–500 μL of complete NK media.
Count live cells and adjust concentration to 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Label a V-bottom 96-well plate for the assay.
Plate appropriate number of enriched NK cells according to effector-to-target ratio.
Bring volume of each well up to 100 μL with complete NK media.
For 2:1 wells, mix 40 μL enriched NK cells (8 × 10^4) with 60 μL complete NK media.
For 1:1 wells, mix 20 μL enriched NK cells (4 × 10^4) with 80 μL complete NK media.
For 0.5:1 wells, mix 10 μL enriched NK cells (2 × 10^4) with 90 μL complete NK media.
Place the plate into a 37°C incubator until target cells are prepared.
Reserve and keep leftover NK cells on ice for staining in "Assess NK Cell Activation" step to assess NK cell activation and purity.
Remove some RMA-S from culture flask and count live cells.
Transfer 5 × 10^6 cells into a 15-mL conical tube and q.s. to 15 mL with DPBS.
Centrifuge cells at 400 × g, 4 min at 20°C–25°C, and aspirate supernatant.
Wash cells once more with 5 mL DPBS; centrifuge cells at 400 × g, 4 min at 20°C–25°C, and aspirate supernatant.
Reconstitute stock CTV in 20 μL DMSO per manufacturer instructions (5 mM after reconstitution).
Make up 10 μM CellTrace Violet working solution: mix 2 μL of 5 mM CTV stock in 1 mL DPBS total.
Resuspend target cell pellet in 1 mL DPBS.
Add 1 mL of 10 μM CTV and mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 15 min at 37°C.
After incubation, add 10 mL warm cRPMI media to the tube.
Incubate for an additional 5 minutes at 37°C.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 4 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL complete NK media.
Count live cells and dilute to a concentration of 4 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Plate 100 μL target cells into each well, containing 40,000 target cells per well.
Incubate for 4 hours at 37°C (up to 6 hours).
Make up the 7-AAD master mix according to the protocol guidelines.
Add 10 μL of 7-AAD master mix to each well and mix by pipetting.
Transfer samples into flow tubes.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 5 minutes.
Analyze on the flow cytometer immediately.
Spin down the assay plate after incubation for flow cytometry analysis if needed.
Centrifuge plate at 400 × g, 4 min at 20°C–25°C, tap out supernatant.
Prepare surface stain master mix according to protocol.
Add 100 μL surface stain master mix to each well, mix.
Incubate for 15 min at 4 degrees in the dark.
Centrifuge plate at 400 × g, 4 min at 20°C–25°C, tap out supernatant after incubation.
Wash the plate twice with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Add FACS buffer, mix.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 4 minutes at 20–25°C.
Tap out supernatant, repeat once more.
Resuspend each well in 200 μL eBioScience Fix/Perm Solution, mix.
Incubate at 4°C for up to 18 hours.
Centrifuge plate at 750 × g for 4 minutes at 4°C, tap out supernatant.
Prepare 1× Permeabilization Buffer by diluting 10× Permeabilization buffer in water.
Add 200 μL 1× Permeabilization to each well, mix.
Centrifuge plate at 750 × g for 4 minutes at 4°C, tap out supernatant.
Make up Granzyme B master mix according to the table:files/protocols_protocol_369_9.csv.
Add 100 μL of Granzyme B master mix to each well, mix.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Wash plate twice with 1× Permeabilization Buffer.
Add 1× Permeabilization Buffer, centrifuge at 750 × g for 4 minutes at 4°C. Tap out supernatant, repeat once more.
Resuspend in 200 μL FACS buffer and analyze on the flow cytometer.
